assumptions.sentence: The C lowering tool (swdb lower, version 9) lowers the C++ proof unit to C that behaves the same; WP proves the C lowering, not the C++.
clang 22.1.8 parses the C++ proof unit correctly for the C lowering tool.
Frama-C/WP 33.0 generates only sound proof obligations for the C lowering under its memory model and the x86_64 machdep.
Z3 5.1.0 answers valid only for valid proof obligations.
CVC5 1.2.1 answers valid only for valid proof obligations.
Alt-Ergo 2.6.4 answers valid only for valid proof obligations.

The checked source-mapped unbounded heap VC translation certifies only the explicit v3 qualified source/type-image domain, accesses, initialization, frame and allocation lifetime. This does not prove the original v2 raw contract or raw effective-type safety. Source-derived caller type/eligibility and cross-view liveness discharge remain required; generic caller composition is unsupported.
Allocation succeeds under the existing fresh-allocation/available-address/frame policy; new typed cells are uninitialized until written.

The pinned Why3 Boolean/map/ordered-arithmetic/absolute-value/division and Frama-C Qed/Cint arithmetic/conversion lemmas are trusted standard proof support; no project desired-result lemma is imported as a hypothesis.
